sentences.text: ?Court No. - 85

Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 3057 of 2022
Applicant :- Hari Pal And Another

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Ajay Kumar Pandey,Sr. Advocate
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Jyotsna Sharma,J.
1.

Heard Sri Ajay Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and
perused the record.
2.

This application has been moved on behalf of the applicants- Hari Pal and Nitin seeking
anticipatory bail during trial in Sessions Trial No.409 of 2020, under sections- 149 and 313 I.P.C.
based on Complaint Case No.663 of 2019, under sections- 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and sections-
3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station- Garhmukteshwar, District- Hapur.
3.  It is contended on behalf of the applicants that they were initially summoned in the aforesaid complaint case under sections- 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and sections- 3/4 D.P. Act.

It is brought to the notice of the Court that in the above complaint case only one person, the husband of the complainant- Mikin Brahmi was summoned for offence under sections 149 and 313 I.P.C. in additional to sections- 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and sections- 3/4 D.P. Act and the case was committed to the Court of Session.
The Court of Session framed charges in additional sections- 313 and 149 I.P.C. against all the accused persons including the present applicants.

It is argued that though the applicants are on bail under sections- 323, 498A, 504, 506 I.P.C. and sections- 3/4 D.P.
Act, however without any cogent reason and without any speaking order, they have been charged in Hari Pal And Another vs State Of U.P. on 18 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/131661864/
1 additional sections of 313 and 149 I.P.C. Therefore, their liberty needs to be protected by grant of anticipatory bail in additional sections only.

sentences.text: It is also contended that Smt. Aneeta and Km. Preeti whose case stood on similar grounds have been given interim protection in a connected matter being Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Application (under section 438 Cr.P.C.) No.907 of 2022.

4. The application for anticipatory bail is opposed by the learned A.G.A.
5.

It may be stated that in case of Siddharam Satlingappa Mhetre v. State of Maharashtra, (2011) 1 SCC 694, it has been held by Hon'ble Supreme Court that while deciding anticipatory bail, Court must consider nature and gravity of accusation, antecedent of accused, possibility of accused to flee from justice and that Court must evaluate entire available material against the accused carefully and that the exact role of the accused has also to be taken into consideration.

entities.text: Siddharam Satlingappa Mhetre v. State of Maharashtra, (2011) 1 SCC 694
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. In the instant case, I considered submissions of the learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusation, role of applicant and all attending facts and circumstances of the case.
In my view, a case for anticipatory bail is made out.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court below shall have the liberty to cancel the bail granted to the applicants.

9. It is made clear that observations made in granting anticipatory bail to the applicants shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion at any stage of the case Hari Pal And Another vs State Of U.P. on 18 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/131661864/
2 based on material before him.
